description: Rebuild-count scenarios for architecture cutoff work. Comparison rows enforce a bound; failing rows record current behavior until the matching architecture mechanism exists.

scenarios.title: No-op rebuild of the benchmark executable
scenarios.notes: Baseline and edited dry-runs should have the same derivation build set.

scenarios.title: Benchmark module body edit rebuild count
scenarios.notes: Real dyndrv build-log mode warms a baseline build, applies a body-only edit, and requires exactly the planner, src/Bench/Model.hs module derivation, and final assemble derivation.

scenarios.title: Thirty-module fixture body edit cutoff
scenarios.notes: Body-only edit in the middle of the thirty-module diamond graph must not rebuild dependents; the exact set is planner, M15, and assemble.

scenarios.title: Thirty-module fixture export edit fanout
scenarios.notes: Export-shape edit to M15 must rebuild M15, all true transitive dependents, app/Main.hs, planner, and assemble, while unrelated M01-M14 modules stay absent.

scenarios.title: Thirty-module fixture no-op cutoff
scenarios.notes: No edit after the warmed baseline must produce no planner rebuild, no module compiles, and no assemble rebuild.

scenarios.title: Template Haskell dependency body edit cutoff
scenarios.notes: Body-only edit in the dependency of a Template Haskell splice must rebuild the dependency object, the dbFull splice module, planner, and assemble; the dbIface sibling module is excluded by the exact set.
